summary.business_type: Informational / official-information site for a real-money rummy app (Pak Rummy); YMYL-adjacent (real-money gaming + payments)
top_findings: /withdrawal/ contradicts itself: intro says processing time unconfirmed, fact table on same page says Verified
Operator identity unresolved sitewide despite Oct 4 'official site' repositioning (official-domains, customer-service, download, privacy-policy still hedge)
16 blog posts indexed but 0 clicks in 90 days -- zero hub pages link down to any post, homepage widget shows only 1 of 16
17% of all search impressions are people trying to reach pakrummy.com itself, converting at only 4.8% CTR with no onward path
Blog publishing cron exhausted its queue after Oct 19 -- 22 days stalled, nothing left to auto-resume
quick_wins: Wire existing dateModified logic into astro.config.mjs sitemap serialize() to fix zero <lastmod> sitewide
Add blog section to the human-readable /sitemap/ page (pattern already exists for guides/updates)
Fix getArticleSchema() to reference Organization @id instead of asserting Editorial Team as a Person
Port Hero.astro fetchpriority/responsive-image pattern to ArticleLayout.astro (blog LCP 2.95s vs 0.95-1.6s elsewhere)
Add above-the-fold link from homepage to pakrummy.com for the 17% of mismatched-intent visitors
Investigate why /card-rummy-vs-pak-rummy/ is unknown to Google despite being in the sitemap

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt AI-crawler block deliberate and correctly structured
Sitemap has exact 1:1 coverage, zero missing/orphaned URLs
Canonicals and trailing-slash handling consistent across all 64 pages, zero duplicate titles/descriptions
Fully static build, zero hydration directives, clean single-hop redirects, real 404 handling

findings.title: No sitewide security headers
findings.description: public/_headers only covers 4 narrow paths (llms.txt, robots.txt, APK content-type, /404). No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add sitewide /* header block; CSP needs to account for inline GA4/GTM scripts in BaseLayout.astro.

findings.title: llms.txt fully hardcoded, missing all new content
findings.description: src/pages/llms.txt.ts lists 0 of 16 blog posts, 0 of 3 guides, and omits /card-rummy-vs-pak-rummy/ entirely. 'Last updated' date is a literal string, not computed.
findings.recommendation: Generate from content collections via getCollection(), matching the pattern already used in src/pages/sitemap/index.astro.

findings.title: HTML /sitemap/ page omits individual blog posts
findings.description: Links guides/updates individually via getCollection() but only links the /blog/ index, not individual posts.
findings.recommendation: Add a blog section using the same getCollection() pattern as guides/updates.

findings.title: No IndexNow implementation
findings.description: No IndexNow ping anywhere in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Add IndexNow submission on publish once Bing Webmaster is verified for this domain.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Verified<T> fact framework is a genuine, structurally-enforced trust mechanism, not cosmetic
No templated/duplicate metadata across 64 pages
Consistent editorial byline presence and AI-citation-friendly 'Direct answer' openings on all articles

findings.title: Site contradicts itself about who runs it
findings.description: Oct 4 'official site' rewrite touched 13 files but missed /customer-service/, /official-domains/, /download/, and the /privacy-policy/ meta description, which still say the operator's identity/domains aren't confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile all operator-identity language to one consistent framing; the site's own scam-checklist content treats this exact gap as a red flag.

findings.title: /withdrawal/ self-contradicts on processing time
findings.description: Intro text says processing time is unconfirmed; the fact table on the same page marks '5-10 minutes' as Verified.
findings.recommendation: Pick one accurate statement and remove the contradiction.

findings.title: No named individual authors anywhere
findings.description: Every article bylined 'Editorial Team', not linked to /authors/ (an 87-word placeholder); article schema types the team as a Person.
findings.recommendation: Either add real named reviewers or make the collective-authorship framing consistent in copy and schema.

findings.title: Zero external citations sitewide
findings.description: None of the 20 articles links to an outside source; the only external link on the entire site is to pakrummy.com.
findings.recommendation: Add citations to primary sources (wallet fee schedules, official app listings, etc.) especially on payment/trust content.

findings.title: Payment-charges blog posts contain no figures
findings.description: The Easypaisa and JazzCash 'withdrawal charges' posts don't answer the question in their own titles.
findings.recommendation: Add sourced, dated fee tables with real rupee figures.

findings.title: Thin core pages
findings.description: /deposit/ 170 words, /withdrawal/ 217, /bonuses/ 205, /about/ 160, /authors/ 87, /updates/ 59.
findings.recommendation: Expand with genuine substance, not padding, consistent with the site's own content philosophy.

findings.title: Stale freshness signals
findings.description: Homepage hard-codes 'Last reviewed 17 August 2026'; /terms/ was edited Oct 4 but still displays 'Last revised 17 August'.
findings.recommendation: Compute displayed review/revision dates from actual edit history instead of a hardcoded string.

findings.title: Factual error in 13-card Rummy walkthrough
findings.description: The 'final declared hand' example totals 12 cards, not 13.
findings.recommendation: Correct the example hand.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles and meta descriptions unique across all 64 pages, rewritten for SEO Oct 4, non-templated

findings.title: No hub page links down to supporting blog content
findings.description: Zero of the 7 game pages, /deposit/, /withdrawal/, /easypaisa-jazzcash/, /account-verification/, /safety/, or /legal-status/ link to any blog post. Homepage blog widget shows only 1 of 16 posts.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual links from every relevant hub page to its supporting posts; raise the homepage widget beyond slice(0,1).

findings.title: Game pages compete with their own supporting blog posts
findings.description: Aviator, Crash, Teen Patti, Poker, and Ludo game pages target the same intent as dedicated blog posts about them; GSC shows at least one target keyword ranking on the wrong page.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate titles/angles or consolidate.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Aug 21 BreadcrumbList @id/duplicate-entry fix verified holding sitewide
Valid JSON-LD syntax sitewide, no fabricated schema types
SoftwareApplication only renders once facts are independently verified, correctly omits fabricated offers/ratings

findings.title: Article schema types Editorial Team as a Person
findings.description: getArticleSchema() declares author as schema.org Person 'PakRummyOfficial.com Editorial Team', contradicting /authors/'s own statement that content has no individual bylines.
findings.recommendation: Reference the existing Organization @id instead.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList items show as 'Unnamed item' in Rich Results Test
findings.description: Distinct from the already-fixed @id bug -- likely missing an explicit name property on each ListItem.
findings.recommendation: Add name to each BreadcrumbList ListItem.

findings.title: SoftwareApplication schema omits SHA-256 checksum and permissions
findings.description: These facts exist in the HTML table but not in structured data, so an agent or system reading only JSON-LD can't recover them.
findings.recommendation: Add as additionalProperty PropertyValue entries, gated on verified status.

findings.title: 5 article pages missing an image property
findings.description: Guides/updates content schemas don't define an image field at all.
findings.recommendation: Add an image field to the guides/updates content collection schema.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Homepage hero LCP 1.59s via fetchpriority + responsive srcset + inlined critical CSS
WebP adoption strong (26 of 34 image assets)
Font loading and TTFB (67-77ms sitewide) in good shape

findings.title: Blog/article template LCP fix never applied
findings.description: ArticleLayout.astro (serves ~25% of the site) uses a plain with no fetchpriority or responsive sizing, shipping a full 1200x630 share-image as the mobile hero. Measured LCP 2.95s vs 0.95-1.6s on every other template.
findings.recommendation: Port the Hero.astro Image/fetchpriority pattern to ArticleLayout.astro.

findings.title: Homepage TBT needs improvement (451ms)
findings.description: Traced to GA4 gtag.js (607ms main-thread) plus a Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon running alongside it.
findings.recommendation: Check for overlap/duplication between the two analytics scripts; consider deferring GA4 init slightly.

findings.title: Unused image asset
findings.description: rummy-game-art.png exists in public/images/ but is unreferenced anywhere; /games/rummy/ has no hero image.
findings.recommendation: Either use it on /games/rummy/ or remove it.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt correctly separates AI training crawlers (blocked) from search and user-triggered agents (allowed) -- deliberate, not a misconfiguration
Download page accessibility tree is agent-ready (real anchors, zero div-onclick widgets)
All 19+ articles open with a 'Direct answer' section, a genuine citability asset

findings.title: llms.txt missing all new content and contradicts verified-fact rules
findings.description: Never reads the blog/guides/updates collections -- missing all 16 blog posts, all 3 guides, 2 standalone pages. Calls /withdrawal/ and /deposit/ facts 'verified' when site.ts marks them unverified.
findings.recommendation: Generate from content collections and align claims with site.ts verification status.

findings.title: Brand entity clarity is weak amid active lookalike-domain competition
findings.description: Lookalike domains (pakrummy.pk, pakrummy.com.pk -- the latter cited by Wikipedia) are winning the 'Pak Rummy' brand narrative in LLM training data. Organization schema has no sameAs/logo/operator link; /official-domains/ itself hedges on domain confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization sameAs/logo, pursue a reciprocal link from pakrummy.com, reconcile /official-domains/ language.

findings.title: AI-training block may be net-negative given the brand-narrative risk
findings.description: Blocking GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot keeps this site's verified, anti-impersonation facts out of model training data while lookalikes remain in it. Blocking Google-Extended also removes Gemini app grounded-answer eligibility specifically.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding ai-input=yes, unblocking PetalBot (search, not training) and Google-Extended, and evaluate allowing GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot as an operator decision.

findings.title: Content-Signal header not repeated in named blocked-bot robots.txt groups
findings.description: Only lives in the wildcard group; the 5 explicitly named/blocked bots never read it (low impact -- already blocked by a stronger Disallow).
findings.recommendation: Repeat the Content-Signal line in each named group for defense-in-depth.

findings.title: Checksum/permissions not machine-queryable
findings.description: Visible in HTML table but absent from SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: See Schema category fix.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 26 of 34 image assets are WebP, remaining exceptions justified (favicons, OG images, small logos)
No broken or placeholder image states found across any captured viewport

findings.title: Unused image asset
findings.description: rummy-game-art.png unreferenced; /games/rummy/ has no hero image.
findings.recommendation: Use or remove.

findings.title: 5 article pages missing structured-data image property
findings.description: See Schema category.
findings.recommendation: See Schema category fix.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Strong, well-handled branded demand (top query 'pakrummy' at 561 impressions/28d)

findings.title: 17% of impressions are people trying to reach pakrummy.com itself
findings.description: 1,532 impressions in 90 days for the game domain and its typos, landing on a homepage with no visible onward link, converting at 4.8% CTR.
findings.recommendation: Add a clear, above-the-fold link/CTA to pakrummy.com.

findings.title: Withdrawal-charges posts don't match ranking page-type for their queries
findings.description: JazzCash post: 0 impressions in 90 days. Easypaisa post: 3 impressions at position 46-66. Competing results are fee tables and official fee-schedule PDFs; these posts have neither.
findings.recommendation: Add sourced, dated fee tables with real figures.

findings.title: /register-login/, old-version APK, and promo-code queries go unanswered
findings.description: 'pak rummy 2026 registration': 30 impressions/0 clicks, only CTA is Download. Old-version APK searches: 210 impressions at 24% CTR unanswered. Promo-code demand split across 3 pages.
findings.recommendation: Add targeted sections/CTAs to each page matching actual query intent.

findings.title: Trust mismatch between homepage claims and page-level verification status
findings.description: Homepage claims Easypaisa/JazzCash support while /easypaisa-jazzcash/ says that support is unverified; withdrawal time is labeled Verified but is only operator-stated.
findings.recommendation: Align claims with actual verification status; distinguish 'Operator-stated' from independently 'Verified'.

findings.title: No usable backlink data obtainable from current sources
findings.description: Moz not configured, Bing verified for a different domain portfolio, Common Crawl hasn't captured this domain. Confidence ceiling 0.50 (Tier 0).
findings.recommendation: Wire up Search Console's Links report via the already-authenticated GSC API.

findings.title: No reciprocal link found from the operator (pakrummy.com)
findings.description: Checked on 3 operator pages (not exhaustive); only a one-way link exists from this site to the operator.
findings.recommendation: Pursue a direct link from the operator as an authority/trust signal.
